paras.text: ii. Writing files character by character
paras.urdu: ii. فائلز میں حرف بہ حرف لکھنا
paras.pashto: ii. دوتنو ته توری په توری لیکل

paras.text: Similarly, using single character stream, data can be written to files character by character by using the function put (). Consider the following program that writes data character by character to an empty file “characterswrite.txt”.
paras.urdu: اسی طرح سنگل کریکٹر اسٹریم کے ذریعے فنکشن put () سے فائلز میں ڈیٹا حرف بہ حرف لکھا جا سکتا ہے۔ درج ذیل پروگرام پر غور کریں جو خالی فائل ’’characterswrite.txt‘‘ میں ڈیٹا حرف بہ حرف لکھتا ہے۔
paras.pashto: همداراز د یو توري بهیر په مرسته د put () فنکشن په کارولو دوتنو ته ډېټا توری په توری لیکل کېدای شي. لاندې پروګرام ته پام وکړئ چې "characterswrite.txt" تشې دوتنې ته ډېټا توری په توری لیکي.

sections.content:
//character stream (read) program #include <conio.h> #include <iostream.h> #include <fstream.h> int main() { char ch; ifstream reads("c:\\charactersfile.txt"); while(!reads.eof()) { read.get(ch); cout<<ch<<endl; } read.close(); getch(); return 0; }

ii. Writing files character by character

Similarly, using single character stream, data can be written to files character by character by using the function put (). Consider the following program that writes data character by character to an empty file “characterswrite.txt”.

//character stream ( write) program #include <conio.h> #include <iostream.h> #include <fstream.h> int main() { char ch; ofstream writes("d:\\characterswrite.txt"); for (int i=0; i<=20; ++i) { cin>>ch; cout<<writes.put(ch); } writes.close(); getch(); return 0; }
